# Agent OS workflow

`CLAUDE.md` is the canonical RadioPad instruction file. Before changing code, read it
and any directory-scoped instructions, including `frontend/CLAUDE.md` for frontend
route work.

For every task, automatically select relevant skills and specialists, plan non-trivial
work, delegate independent PR-sized units when that improves safety or speed, coordinate
dependencies, and perform focused validation. Keep trivial work inline. Make routine
decisions autonomously and ask only for genuine requirements, authorization, or safety
blockers.

This workflow does not grant extra permissions or override user approval, repository
rules, security boundaries, protected Git operations, secrets policy, or the rule that
heavy validation runs in GitHub Actions.
